messages:
nora: hi all, first-week blocker  my PR's buildkite job failed at the artifact upload step with a 403 from S3 and GitHub shows a failed required check so i can't merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/99
tara: welcome @nora! sorry about that. can you paste the failing log snippet?
nora: sure:
```
Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/pr-99/
Error: AccessDenied: Access Denied
status code: 403, request id: ABCDEFG123456
```
nora: buildkite job id bk-9001 if that helps.
infra-oncall: @nora thanks. quick Q: is this a branch on the main repo or from a fork?
nora: branch on the main repo (feature/nora/onboard).
sam: two likely causes: 1) the pipeline's S3 creds were rotated and the agent pool hasn't picked up the new role; or 2) the job is running on a runner in the wrong account where the IAM role isn't attached.
tara: i can see bk-9001 ran on runner "ci-eu-3" which was recently decommissioned last week. infra switched some runners to a new role and we should've migrated its instance profile. infra-oncall can you confirm?
infra-oncall: checking runner metadata... yep runner "ci-eu-3" still has old instance profile that no longer has S3 write permissions. i'll cordon that runner and re-run the job. give me 60s.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" queued for PR #99 (job id: bk-9002).
merge-bot: merge blocked  required checks failing: buildkite/artifacts.
infra-oncall: cordoned runner ci-eu-3 and requeued job to ci-eu-5 which has the correct role. re-run started.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" started for PR #99 (job id: bk-9002).
nora: re-run in progress, thanks.
buildkite-bot: artifact upload step succeeded for job bk-9002 ✅
merge-bot: merge allowed  all required checks passed.
nora: merged! thank you so much. definitely a helpful onboarding lesson about runner hygiene :sweat_smile:
tara: welcome aboard @nora :tada: i'll follow up in the handbook with a short note about how to interpret artifact 403s and who to ping. also tag #eng-infra-runner when you see runner names in logs, we can action faster.
infra-oncall: follow-up: i'll schedule a short housekeeping run to rotate stale instance profiles next week so this doesn't recur.
